create_qmnist_train_dataset: create a QMNIST dataset object to load the training split with image and label data
create_qmnist_test_dataset: create a QMNIST dataset object to load the test split with 60k examples
load_qmnist_nist_subset: load the full NIST digits dataset using the QMNIST class with what set to nist
read_idx3_ubyte_images: read an IDX3-ubyte format file and return a torch tensor of grayscale images
read_idx2_int_labels: read an IDX2-int format file and return a torch tensor of integer label data
